page_title: PSG 3-0 HAV | PSG v Le Havre 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
90+2' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
90+2' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Mory Diaw gets down to his right to keep it out.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Lucas Hernandez (PSG) is penalised for holding. Mathieu Vernice signals a set piece.
89' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
87' 3 - 0 Goal Bradley Barcola (PSG)! Bradley Barcola (PSG) was put through by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 3:0.
86' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) attempts to release Ibrahim Mbaye with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
85' The resulting corner from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) is cleared.
84' Didier Digard decides to make a substitution. Rassoul Ndiaye will be replaced by Felix Mambimbi (Le Havre).
84' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Loic Nego as he is replaced by Younes Namli (Le Havre).
80' There's an opportunity for Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
80' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
79' CHANCE! Nuno Mendes (PSG) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
79' Nuno Mendes (PSG) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) is replacing Yassine Kechta.
73' Mory Diaw (Le Havre) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
72' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
71' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) replacing Senny Mayulu.
71' Substitution. Fabian Ruiz (PSG) on for Vitinha.

70' OFF THE POST! Issa Soumare (Le Havre) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the right post! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Quentin Ndjantou (PSG) was quite harsh and Mathieu Vernice didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
69' The ball is cleared after Vitinha (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

65' 2 - 0 One of the defending players blocked the first attempt, but the ball lands at the feet of Joao Neves (PSG) and he unleashes an unstoppable shot which goes in off the right post. No chance for the goalkeeper.
64' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Goncalo Ramos and he is replaced by Quentin Ndjantou (PSG).
64' Lucas Beraldo will be replaced by Lucas Hernandez (PSG).
64' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) is flagged for offside.
62' The resulting corner from Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) comes to nothing.
62' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Lucas Chevalier to dive and make a save.
61' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) will take the free kick.
61' Mathieu Vernice shows a yellow card to Nuno Mendes (PSG) for his blatant foul.
60' Half-chance! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) plays a pass into the box, but Mory Diaw reacts well to snuff out the attack.
58' Problems for Didier Digard as Abdoulaye Toure is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Reda Khadra (Le Havre) replaces him.
55' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Bradley Barcola (PSG) will replace Kang-In Lee.
55' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
55' Joao Neves (PSG) plays a through ball but overhits it.
52' A precise low pass is received by Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
49' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
47' CLOSE! Senny Mayulu (PSG) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post!
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Vitinha (PSG) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
45+1' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom right corner. Mory Diaw is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
43' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) picks up the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort that sails well over the crossbar and ends in the stands.
42' The shots on goal statistics – 4:3.
39' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
39' Le Havre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

39' Well-positioned Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the right post, but Lucas Chevalier reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop! It will be a corner kick for Le Havre.
37' Joao Neves (PSG) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
36' Kang-In Lee (PSG) is about to take a corner kick.
36' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The linesman makes the right call and PSG will have a corner.
32' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mathieu Vernice had an easy-decision to make.
31' Loic Nego (Le Havre) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
29' 1 - 0 What a hit! Kang-In Lee (PSG) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
28' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for PSG.
27' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. PSG earn a corner.
27' Le Havre fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
26' A header by Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) from very close range goes towards the middle of the target, but doesn't get past Lucas Chevalier, who makes a nice save.
24' A rebound falls to Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the left post.
22' A pass from Kang-In Lee (PSG) is intercepted by Mory Diaw and the move breaks down.
20' Le Havre showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
17' Vitinha (PSG) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
17' Vitinha (PSG) picks up an injury.

14' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Lucas Chevalier shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
12' Kang-In Lee (PSG) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the left side of the goal. Mory Diaw is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
11' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) takes the corner.
11' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Issa Soumare (Le Havre). Le Havre win a corner.
8' Loic Nego (Le Havre) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Joao Neves (PSG) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
7' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
5' The linesman signals that Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
5' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.

4' Nuno Mendes (PSG) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Mory Diaw, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
3' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
2' PSG are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

PSG will kick the game off.
